On-Site in NW Austin
Who We Are:At NCC/ProMax, we combine a powerful credit/compliance engine with the industry’s only digital retailing-enabled CRM suite – refining every part of the dealership management, from financing and lender selection to desking, marketing, and data mining. Dealers can optimize every deal by credit score when that synergy happens on a single, seamless software platform. Target and market more intelligently. And get deals done at maximum efficiency…and maximum profit.
Our teams work together to follow our core values of WE ARE: Aspirational, Entrepreneurial, Impactful, One Team, and Respectful.
If this sounds interesting, join us!
Summary:We're seeking Account Executives to join our sales organization and drive revenue by selling NCC’s auto credit products. Your primary goal is to capture new automotive dealer customers via daily outbound calling and selling efforts. Each Automotive Credit Account Executive must successfully build and maintain a pipeline of qualified customers. The ideal candidate will have a B2B Inside Sales background, be collaborative, assertive, organized, metrics-driven, and display strong accountability and focus.
What You'll Do: Manage the entire sales cycle of the Auto Credit Solution, including prospecting, running discovery calls and demos, negotiating, and closing new business.Maintaining a solid pipeline of prospective customers will be critical to future success.Ability to reach the decision-makers in the automotive dealership space and negotiate deals from initial presentation through a signed contract.Source and leverage Salesforce and other tools to effectively manage pipeline, sales opportunities, and daily activities.
What You'll Bring:Minimum of three (3) years of experience working in an outbound calling B2B sales environment.Demonstrated success in prospecting for new customer relationships via telemarketing efforts.Ability to understand the value proposition of a service offering and identify all opportunities to effectively communicate this offering to key dealership management and ownership level personnel.
What We Offer:Base plus commission (55K plus 55K with accelerator opportunity)Commission paid monthly4-month rampUnlimited PTOMedical/Dental/Vision
Interview Process:Recruiter ScreenIn-Person Interview w/Hiring Managers & Chief Sales OfficerOffer
About Us:National Credit Center (NCC) has provided credit, soft pull, and compliance solutions to the automotive industry since 1996. NCC’s comprehensive solutions help dealers improve sales, reduce costs, and efficiently comply with regulations.
Our mission is to Deliver insightful, data-driven solutions that enable our customers to optimize profitable decisions.
Please visit our website at www.nccdirect.com for company, services, and product information.We are an equal employment opportunity employer and a drug-free workplace.
